name: חֵן
summary: The noun חֵן. In Zec 6:14 the crowns made for Joshua the high priest are kept in the temple “for a memorial” for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah “and for Hen son of Zephaniah”: the Josiah son of Zephaniah of 6:10, in whose house the exiles from Babylon were received. TIPNR takes Hen as a second name of that Josiah.

evidence.note: “The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, וּלְחֵן son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Yahweh.”
“Go into the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.”
“Behold the man whose name is the Branch … he shall build the temple of Yahweh.”

note: Takes h.dz.ad (1 token). Hen may be a second name of Josiah, as TIPNR takes it, or the noun “favour” (“for the kindness of the son of Zephaniah”); the parallel list of 6:10 favours a name.
